metadata.name: E. fimbriata oocyte and elemental composition data from Senegalese coastal waters
metadata.description: Dataset containing measurements of E. fimbriata oocyte diameter and volume, lipid and protein content, calorific values, elemental concentrations (Ba/Ca, Sr/Ca, Zn/Ca), and spawning batch energy content for the fish species E. fimbriata. Environmental parameters including water temperature and salinity are also recorded. Samples were collected from three locations (Foundiougne, Djifer, Joal) along the Senegalese coast between February and October 2014.

metadata.name: MITAPI 2010-2015 difference files
metadata.description: Collection of 12 NetCDF files containing difference/anomaly data from the MITAPI project covering the period 2010-2015, with various variables/regions identified by suffix codes

metadata.name: Elwha River Delta GPS Survey
metadata.description: GPS survey data from the Elwha River Delta collected on March 20, 2011. Contains 211 fixed-position observations with latitude, longitude, elevation, horizontal and vertical RMS accuracy values, and station descriptions including monitoring points and profiling locations.

metadata.name: Elwha River Delta GPS Survey
metadata.description: GPS survey data from the Elwha River Delta collected on 2012-02-03, containing 106 fixed-position observations with latitude, longitude, elevation, and horizontal/vertical RMS accuracy values.

metadata.name: Permafrost Extent - Mean Annual Ground Temperature and Permafrost Probability for Antarctica
metadata.description: Associated files for a permafrost dataset containing Mean Annual Ground Temperature (MAGTM), MAGT Standard Deviation, and Permafrost Probability Fraction for Antarctica, covering the period 2000-2017. Published by Obu et al. 2019.

metadata.name: Supplementary files for El Bizri et al. 2019 - Hunting and pregnancy data
metadata.description: Catalog of supplementary Excel files containing interviews on pregnancy diagnoses, pacas hunting registers, and catch-per-unit-effort records associated with the publication by El Bizri et al. 2019.

metadata.name: Laboratory measurements of shell properties and seawater carbonate chemistry for Magallana hongkongensis from Zhanjiang
metadata.description: Laboratory experiment measuring shell mechanical properties (area porosity, stiffness, hardness, density, volume) and seawater carbonate system parameters (pH, temperature, salinity, pCO₂, total alkalinity, dissolved inorganic carbon, and aragonite/calcite saturation states) for the oyster species Magallana hongkongensis collected from Zhanjiang, China.

metadata.name: Neumayer SPUSO Aerosol Size Distribution Measurements 2018
metadata.description: Hourly aerosol particle number size distribution measurements (dN/dlogDp) from 92.87 nm to 4845.51 nm diameter bins, collected at Neumayer Station, Antarctica during the SPUSO campaign in 2018. The dataset contains 8518 records with 60 size bins, along with temporal metadata (start/end times, duration) and spatial coordinates.

metadata.name: Aerosol size distribution measurements at Neumayer station
metadata.description: Hourly aerosol number size distribution measurements (dN/dlogDp) across 64 size channels ranging from approximately 93 nm to 4846 nm particle diameter, collected at the Neumayer research station in Antarctica during 2019. The dataset includes timestamps, geographic coordinates, and event identifiers.

metadata.name: Katharinentalerhof Pforzheim - Linked Data Catalog of Associated Files
metadata.description: Catalog of 12 data files associated with the Katharinentalerhof Pforzheim event, including eddy covariance data, plant performance data, weather data, and Noah-MP model simulations. All files are hosted at PANGAEA (Bohm et al. 2020).

metadata.name: Biological and biochemical measurements of fish from Macapule Lagoon
metadata.description: Dataset containing biological and biochemical measurements of fish collected from Macapule Lagoon between December 2013 and August 2015. The data includes morphometric measurements (length, mass, eviscerated mass), organ weights (gut wet mass, liver mass, stomach wet mass, heart mass), hepatosomatic index (HSI), and biochemical parameters (potassium, glycogen reserve index, total protein, triglycerides, cholesterol, glucose) for individual fish. Samples were collected across different seasons (Winter and Summer) and size categories (Cat: 18, 20, 22). All samples were taken from a single location at latitude 25.35, longitude -108.5.

metadata.name: Water quality measurements at Macapule Lagoon
metadata.description: Water quality parameters including temperature, salinity, dissolved oxygen, pH, ammonia, nitrate, and phosphate measured at Macapule Lagoon from December 2013 to June 2015.

metadata.name: Laboratory experiment on Mytilus galloprovincialis embryo development under ocean acidification conditions
metadata.description: Laboratory experiment investigating the effects of elevated CO2 (ocean acidification) on early development stages of the Mediterranean mussel Mytilus galloprovincialis. The dataset contains measurements of embryo development percentages across multiple developmental stages (1-cell through D-larva), morphological measurements (length, height), and seawater chemistry parameters (pH, temperature, salinity, DIC, CO2, bicarbonate, carbonate, calcium, and saturation states) under control and high CO2 treatment conditions.

metadata.name: Whale and dolphin observations during PS87 track survey
metadata.description: Marine mammal sighting records from the PS87 track survey, including species identification (whales and dolphins), observation certainty, number of individuals, and precise geographic coordinates with timestamps.

metadata.name: Atmospheric Balloon Sounding Data from August 18, 2018
metadata.description: Atmospheric sounding measurements from a balloon launch on August 18, 2018, including pressure, temperature, relative humidity, wind direction, wind speed, and altitude measurements recorded at approximately 1-second intervals over a 30-minute period.

metadata.name: IODP Expedition 370 Site C0023A sediment core geochemical measurements
metadata.description: Sediment core samples from IODP Expedition 370, Site C0023A, containing depth measurements and geochemical peak area data (alkene and diol peak areas) for 20 core sections.

metadata.name: UPC Sensor Output Files
metadata.description: Dataset containing binary sensor output files (ZIP archives) from a UPC event, with associated metadata including geographic coordinates, elevation, and collection date.

metadata.name: Birkeland Cruise Siphonophore Video Recordings
metadata.description: Video recordings of siphonophores collected during the Birkeland Cruise, including fish siphonophores and other siphonophore species. The dataset contains 2 video files with associated metadata including geographic coordinates and timestamps.

metadata.name: Aerosol chemical composition measurements from RV Polarstern expeditions PS106
metadata.description: Size-segregated aerosol chemical composition measurements collected at 25m height during RV Polarstern expeditions PS106/1-track and PS106/2-track. The dataset contains concentrations of major ions (Cl-, NO3-, SO4 2-, oxalate, NO2-, Br-, F-, MSA, PO4 3-) and cations (Na+, NH4+, K+, Mg2+) across five aerosol size ranges (0.05-10 μm) using a multi-stage impactor sampler.

metadata.name: Stordalen permafrost peatland sediment core age-depth data
metadata.description: Sediment core data from the Stordalen_2 permafrost peatland site in Sweden, containing 27 samples with depth measurements, sediment thickness, and radiocarbon ages ranging from 1898 to 2003. Includes 11 radiocarbon dated samples with dating material information (moss, Carex, Betula, sphagnum Lindbergii, beetle/bark) and laboratory labels from LuS and Poz laboratories.

metadata.name: NunaWP4 Mackenzie River Water Isotope Measurements
metadata.description: Water isotope measurements (δ18O and δD) and deuterium excess (d xs) from water samples collected during the NunaWP4 Mackenzie expedition. The dataset contains 146 samples collected across 4 expeditions in the Mackenzie River region between April and September 2019.

metadata.name: Fluorescent Dissolved Organic Matter Measurements from the Mackenzie Shelf and Beaufort Sea, 2019
metadata.description: Dataset containing in-situ measurements of fluorescent dissolved organic matter (fDOM) and intrinsic fluorescence (IFDOM) parameters collected from 146 station samples across 4 expeditions in the Mackenzie River plume region and adjacent Beaufort Sea during 2019. Measurements include FDOM peak intensities (A-peak, C-peak, M-peak, T-peak), intrinsic fluorescence components (C1, C2, C3), and fluorescence indices (FI, HI, BI) at various stations along the Mackenzie Shelf.

metadata.name: Water vapor isotopic composition and mix ratio measurements
metadata.description: Hourly water vapor isotopic measurements (δ18O and δD of H2O) and water vapor mix ratio data collected at a fixed location in Antarctica (latitude -70.65, longitude -8.25, elevation 42m) from February 2017 to January 2019.

metadata.name: WDC06A Ice Core Measurements
metadata.description: Ice core measurements from the WDC06A core including depth, gas age, isotopic ratios (δ18O, δ18O_2), and other measurements (Δ36, Δ36_2).

metadata.name: Geochemical analysis of deep-sea sediment core SO268/1_43-1
metadata.description: Elemental concentration data from deep-sea sediment core samples collected during the German collector trial pre-impact expedition (cruise SO268). The dataset contains concentrations of major elements (Al, Ca, Fe, K, Mg, Na), trace elements (Ba, Cr, Cu, La, Li, Mn, Ni, P, Sr, Ti), and their relative abundances at various sediment depths (0.0625–0.225 m) from station SO268_043MUC in the eastern Pacific Ocean.

metadata.name: Belgian collector trial pre-impact core sample geochemistry
metadata.description: Geochemical analysis of sediment core samples from the Belgian collector trial pre-impact experiment. The dataset contains elemental concentrations (Al, Ba, Ca, Cr, Cu, Fe, K, La, Li, Mg, Mn, Na, Ni, P, Sr, Ti) and their relative abundances from core SO268/1_74-1, collected at a single deep-ocean station (elevation -4518.1 m).

metadata.name: Sylt benthic trawl survey - Atlantic mackerel and environmental measurements
metadata.description: Benthic trawl survey data from the Sylt region in the North Sea, containing Atlantic mackerel (Scomber scombrus) total length and count measurements, along with bathymetry, salinity, and temperature data collected during trawl events.

metadata.name: PS122/5_61-35 ROV Quicklook Images Metadata
metadata.description: Metadata for 22 quicklook image files generated during the PS122/5_61-35 ROV dive on 2020-09-08. The dataset includes links to binary image files (ADCP, depth profile, ECO, GPCTD, optics, positioning, sea ice, telemetry, transmittance, VIPER spectra, and pH overview) collected at a single location in the Arctic Ocean (88.68°N, 112.32°E) at a depth of approximately 4291 m.

metadata.name: Topographic and Geographic Location Files
metadata.description: Collection of geographic location files (ZIP archives) referencing various mountains, hills, and islands, along with a topographic high raw data Excel file. The dataset contains file references rather than actual coordinate or measurement data.

metadata.name: Manganese Nodule Samples from the Clarion-Clipperton Zone and Nearby Regions
metadata.description: Dataset containing 7 manganese nodule samples collected during oceanographic expeditions in 1970. Samples include whole nodules and nodule fragments with geochemical analyses of manganese (Mn), iron (Fe), nickel (Ni), cobalt (Co), and copper (Cu) concentrations. Samples were collected from the Pacific Ocean, primarily in the Clarion-Clipperton Fracture Zone (CCZ) region, with depths ranging from approximately 3,755 to 5,340 meters below sea level.

metadata.name: Boreogadus saida (Arctic cod) specimens from Arctic expeditions
metadata.description: Collection of preserved Boreogadus saida (Arctic cod) specimens collected during multiple German Arctic expeditions (PS80, PS92, PS106/2, PS122). The dataset contains morphometric measurements including total length (TL), standard length (SL), wet mass, sex, condition index, and stomach content analysis (stomach mass, stomach content mass, degree of digestion). Samples were collected using various gear types (SUIT trawl, RMT, ROV, hand collection, seawater tap) from Arctic waters, with geographic coordinates and depth/elevation data.

metadata.name: Total Phosphorus Concentrations in Lake Constance (Fischbach-Uttwil)
metadata.description: Total phosphorus (TP) concentration measurements in Lake Constance at the Fischbach-Uttwil monitoring station, spanning 1951-2010. Data includes summer (July-September) concentrations averaged over the upper 20m of the water column, and winter mixing period concentrations for the entire water column.

metadata.name: Manganese Nodule Geochemical Composition from PLDS04MV-109BX
metadata.description: Geochemical analysis of manganese nodules collected from the Clarion-Clipperton Zone in the Pacific Ocean. The dataset contains 3 samples with elemental concentrations (major, trace, and rare earth elements) for topside, underside, and bulk composition of Mn nodules. All samples were collected at a single station (PLDS04MV-109BX) at a depth of 4722 m on 1976-08-27.

metadata.name: Pore water chemistry of sediment samples from M186_50-1GC station
metadata.description: Pore water chemistry data from 18 sediment core samples collected at station M186_50-1GC. The dataset contains concentrations of nutrients (nitrate, nitrite, ammonium, phosphate), major ions (chloride, sulfate, bromide, boron), and trace elements (manganese, calcium, iron, sodium, magnesium, strontium, silicon, barium, lithium, potassium) measured across sediment depths ranging from 0.29 to 3.64 meters.

metadata.name: Porewater chemistry from sediment core M186_54-1GC
metadata.description: Porewater chemistry data from sediment core M186_54-1GC collected at a single station (38.74553°N, 28.56587°W) at a depth of -1234 m. The dataset contains concentrations of major and trace ions and elements (alkalinity, nitrate, nitrite, ammonium, phosphate, chloride, sulfate, bromide, boron, manganese, calcium, iron, sodium, magnesium, strontium, silicon, barium, lithium, potassium) measured at 19 sediment depth intervals ranging from 0.28 to 3.81 m below seafloor.

metadata.name: Laboratory experiment on Limacina helicina carbonate chemistry and respiration under varying CO2 conditions
metadata.description: Laboratory incubation experiment on the pteropod Limacina helicina measuring carbonate system parameters (pHT, DIC, AT, pCO2, bicarbonate, carbonate, aragonite and calcite saturation states) and oxygen consumption rates under supersaturated and undersaturated CO2 conditions. Samples include controls, initial collections, and incubations with 2-4 individuals over approximately 8-9 hours.

metadata.name: Baltic Sea pCO2 climatology and trend
metadata.description: Dataset containing Baltic Sea partial pressure of CO2 (pCO2) data, including a climatology and a long-term trend analysis.

metadata.name: Chemical composition of pelagic tunicate (salp) samples from multiple oceanographic expeditions
metadata.description: Biological samples of pelagic tunicates (primarily salp species) collected during multiple oceanographic expeditions, with measurements of wet/dry mass, ash content, ash-free dry mass, and elemental composition (carbon, nitrogen, hydrogen percentages and ratios). Samples span four geographic regions: Northeast Pacific, Hawaii, Southern Ocean, and Chatham Rise.

metadata.name: Ice and snow core samples from NM01_04_S01 event
metadata.description: Dataset containing 53 ice and snow core samples collected on 2004-12-29 at a single location in Antarctica (approximately 70.65°S, 8.25°W). Each sample includes depth measurements (ice/snow depth and descriptive depth), ice density values, and associated imagery. Samples are identified by unique sample numbers (e.g., J*-05-NM-60).

metadata.name: Physico-chemical, Particulate Matter, Temperature, and Hydrological Data
metadata.description: A collection of datasets containing physico-chemical data (in situ parameters, nutrients, trace elements, contaminants), particulate matter data (cations, trace elements, mineralogy via X-Ray Diffraction), continuous temperature data at sampling sites, and hydrological data (modeled and measured mean daily discharge from 14 sampling sites).

metadata.name: Porites coral geochemical records (Sr/Ca, Mg/Ca, δ18O, δ13C) from TIAREI-A1
metadata.description: Dataset containing 96 geochemical measurements from Porites sp. coral samples, including strontium/calcium (Sr/Ca), magnesium/calcium (Mg/Ca), oxygen isotope (δ18O), and carbon isotope (δ13C) ratios. All samples originate from a single location (latitude -17.506944, longitude -149.4225, elevation -15.0 m) collected on 2008-07-01 under event TIAREI-A1.

metadata.name: Porites sp. geochemical and isotopic records from TIAREI-3B
metadata.description: High-resolution Sr/Ca, Mg/Ca, δ18O, and δ13C measurements from Porites sp. coral samples collected at a single location in French Polynesia (17.5°S, 149.4°W, 15 m depth). The dataset contains 91 sub-annual (approximately monthly) measurements spanning the period 2000–2008, providing a proxy record of sea surface conditions.

metadata.name: Flade Isblink ice cap cryoconite and sediment radionuclide measurements
metadata.description: Dataset containing 48 samples collected from the Flade Isblink ice cap in northeastern Greenland during August 2022. The samples include cryoconite (46 samples) and river sediment (2 samples, one glacial and one non-glacial). Measurements include concentrations of radionuclides (137Cs, 210Pb, 214Pb, 241Am, 207Bi, 228Ac, 7Be, 40K, 238Pu, 239+240Pu) with associated uncertainties, loss on ignition (LOI), carbon content, and plutonium isotope ratios (238/239+240Pu atom ratio and 240Pu/239Pu atom ratio). Samples were collected at the ice surface (depth 0) with GPS coordinates and elevation recorded.

metadata.name: Santiurde section sediment composition and stratigraphy
metadata.description: Geochemical and mineralogical analysis of 19 sediment samples from the Santiurde section, including thickness, stratigraphic height, and relative abundances of quartz (Qz), clay, calcite (Cal), gypsum (Gp), dolomite (Dol), and pyrite (Py). All samples were collected at a single location in northern Spain (43.0685608, -4.0878295) at an elevation of 730 m. No temporal coverage information is available as the Date/Time field is empty.

metadata.name: DML 2021/22 Snow Density and Radar Profile Measurements
metadata.description: Dataset containing 578 records of snow density measurements at various depths, along with radar reflection profiles and snow property measurements (ice/snow depth, top and bottom depths) collected during the DML21/22 campaign in Dronning Maud Land, Antarctica.

metadata.name: Puchalski AWS Antarctic Meteorological Observations
metadata.description: Daily meteorological observations from the Puchalski automatic weather station in Antarctica, including minimum/mean/maximum temperature, relative humidity, wind speed, and snow water depth measurements from 2018 to 2023.

metadata.name: Kazusa Group magnetostratigraphy from Chiba, Japan
metadata.description: Magnetostratigraphic data from the Kazusa Group in the Chiba region of Japan, including sample IDs, section depths, magnetic polarity reversal (SR) values, and geographic coordinates from the Ono River and Yuki River sections. Data sourced from this study and Kuwano et al. (2021).

metadata.name: Paleomagnetic data from sediment cores with VGP coordinates and age model
metadata.description: Dataset containing 343 paleomagnetic measurements from sediment cores, including declination, inclination, their uncertainties, directional statistics (α95, kappa), relative paleointensity (RPI) with uncertainties, and Virtual Geomagnetic Pole (VGP) latitude/longitude with uncertainties. Data spans sediment depths from 0.28 to 3.7 and ages from 0.234 to 6.362.

metadata.name: Uelzen, Germany satellite imagery and vegetation indices
metadata.description: Satellite imagery (GeoTIFFs) and shapefiles for Uelzen, Germany (site c3126), including 6-band color composites, vegetation indices, and metabolism indices from 1984 to 2023.

metadata.name: Aalen, Germany - Satellite Imagery and Vegetation Indices (1984-2023)
metadata.description: Satellite imagery data including 6-band color composites and vegetation/metabolism indices for Aalen, Germany, along with associated shapefiles. The dataset spans from 1984 to 2023 with observations primarily in May-August and July-October periods.

metadata.name: Pyrite δ³⁴S and methane data from marine sediments and rocks
metadata.description: A compilation of pyrite sulfur isotope (δ³⁴S Py) measurements, methane content, and associated geochemical data (CaCO₃, TOC, sulfur reduction rates) from marine sediment cores and rock samples worldwide. The dataset includes sample type, lithology, water depth, distance to shore, elevation, sediment depth, and age information, sourced from 94 published references.

metadata.name: Luminescence dating of soil samples from NEP sites
metadata.description: Luminescence dating dataset containing 7 soil samples from two event locations (NEP_1 and NEP_3) in southern Germany. The dataset includes geographic coordinates, elevation, soil depth, and gamma dose rate measurements (U, Th, K concentrations and uncertainties), equivalent dose (De) values with uncertainties, and calculated ages (Age dated and Age dated_2) with their respective errors. Samples were collected on 2023-04-03.

metadata.name: Radiocarbon and U-series dating records from Borneo archaeological sites
metadata.description: Collection of 335 radiocarbon and U-series dating measurements from 42 archaeological sites across Borneo (Malaysia and Indonesia), including both calibrated and uncalibrated ages with associated uncertainties and references.

metadata.name: Geochemical composition of samples from Arctic Ocean cruise PS101/186
metadata.description: Major element oxide weight percentage data (SiO2, TiO2, Al2O3, Fe2O3, MnO, MgO, CaO, Na2O, K2O, P2O5) for two samples collected at a single location in the Arctic Ocean during PANGAEA cruise PS101.

metadata.name: Marine sediment geochemistry and isotopic data from DSDP/ODP Leg 112 Site 680
metadata.description: Geochemical and isotopic measurements of marine sediment cores from DSDP/ODP Leg 112, Site 680, including major and trace element concentrations (Al, Ca, Fe, K, Mn, Na, P, Mo, U), total organic carbon (TOC) and total carbon (TC), elemental ratios (Fe/Al, Mn/Al, Mo xs, U xs, enrichment factors), iron speciation (Feac, FeD, Femag, Fe Py, Fe react), and stable isotope ratios (δ15N, δ13C Corg, δ98Mo auth). Samples span Pleistocene and Pliocene epochs, collected at a single location off the coast of Peru.

metadata.name: MSM44_362-1 P-wave velocity and sediment core measurements
metadata.description: Sediment core measurements from cruise MSM44, event 362-1, including P-wave travel time, acoustic velocity (Vp-a), acoustic grain density (AGR), core diameter deviation, and depth measurements. All samples were taken at a single location in the Arctic (75.98°N, 66.05°W) at a water depth of 705 m on 2015-07-12.

metadata.name: Sucha Woda Flood Boulder Measurements
metadata.description: Measurements of boulder diameters and site characteristics from 11 locations surveyed after the Sucha Woda Flood event on July 24, 2018. Data includes site coordinates, elevation, number of tree trunks, and up to 25 boulder diameter measurements per site.

metadata.name: Antarctic EMR Radar Profiles 1997/98
metadata.description: Metadata catalog of EMR (Electromagnetic Radar) profile data collected during the Antarctic expedition 1997/98. Contains 97 radar profiles with associated netCDF data files, GIS/KML files, and image files. Profiles were collected using EMR instruments with 600 ns and 60 ns pulse settings.

metadata.name: Laboratory experiment on Xenia umbellata pulsation rates across different treatments
metadata.description: Laboratory experiment measuring pulsation rates of Xenia umbellata (a species of soft coral) under different treatment conditions including Zooplankton, Control, DOC (Dissolved Organic Carbon), and Phytoplankton treatments across 12 tanks over 28 days.

metadata.name: Stable isotope measurements (δ13C and δ18O) from Uvigerina spp. in sediment core M78/1_181-3
metadata.description: 219 samples of stable carbon (δ13C) and oxygen (δ18O) isotope measurements from Uvigerina spp. foraminifera in a sediment core, with corresponding depth, age, and geographic location data.

metadata.name: IBCR Expedition 386 M0095B Sediment Core Mineralogy Data
metadata.description: Mineralogical composition data from sediment core samples collected during IBCR Expedition 386, Site M0095B. The dataset contains 14 samples with quantitative mineral abundances (in percent or relative units) for minerals including quartz, plagioclase, sodic plagioclase, muscovite, biotite, chlorite, amphibole, and various clay minerals. Samples span sediment depths from 0.21 to 26.81 meters. All samples were collected at a single location in the Pacific Ocean at approximately 36.89°N, 143.41°E, at a water depth of 7697 meters below sea level. Samples were collected on 2021-05-30.

metadata.name: Sediment core geochemical data from boreholes BH-II and BH-rec
metadata.description: Geochemical analysis of sediment cores from two boreholes (BH-II and BH-rec) including total organic carbon (TOC), black carbon (BC), calcium carbonate (CaCO3), pH, grain size distribution (2000-63 µm, 63-2 µm, <2 µm, <0.2 µm), magnetic susceptibility, total phosphorus, heavy metals (Pb, Zn, Cu), sulfur content, stable carbon (δ13C) and nitrogen (δ15N) isotopes, and elevation data.

metadata.name: ODP Expedition 383 Site U1539 Sediment Core SST Data
metadata.description: Sediment core samples from ODP Expedition 383 (Sites U1539A, U1539C, U1539D) containing depth, age, cluster assignments, sea surface temperature (SST) estimates with standard deviations, geographic coordinates, elevation, and collection dates for 150 working samples.

metadata.name: North Pacific and Arctic Ocean sediment core geochemical and grain size data
metadata.description: Geochemical and grain size measurements from sediment cores collected in the North Pacific and Arctic Ocean regions. The dataset contains 140 records across 10 sampling events (NPAL04, NPAL05, NPAL07, NPAL08, NPAL12, NPAL14, NPAL15, NPAL17, NPAL19, AeN_Q1_P1_BC1). Measurements include total organic carbon (TOC), total inorganic carbon (TIC), total nitrogen (TN), stable isotope ratios (δ13C, δ15N), grain size fractions (>63 µm, 63-2 µm, <2 µm), sedimentation rate, accumulation rate, sediment depth, and elevation. Data were collected between September 2018 and March 2021.

metadata.name: GeoB16310-2 sediment core TOC and TIC measurements
metadata.description: Total Organic Carbon (TOC) and Total Inorganic Carbon (TIC) measurements from sediment core GeoB16310-2, collected at a single location in the Gulf of Mexico at a water depth of approximately 565 meters. The dataset contains 15 depth-resolved samples with carbon concentration data.

metadata.name: GeoB16310-3 sediment core TOC and TIC measurements
metadata.description: Sediment core GeoB16310-3 containing 23 depth-resolved measurements of Total Organic Carbon (TOC) and Total Inorganic Carbon (TIC) from the Gulf of Mexico. Samples were collected at a single station (23.824167°N, 87.170333°W) at a water depth of 573 m on March 23, 2012. Core depths range from 0.10 to 10.38 meters.

metadata.name: GeoB16320-2 sediment core geochemical analysis
metadata.description: Geochemical measurements (Total Organic Carbon and Total Inorganic Carbon) from sediment core GeoB16320-2 collected at a single location in the Gulf of Mexico. The dataset contains 34 depth-resolved samples with TOC and TIC concentrations, along with depth, elevation, and collection timestamp.

metadata.name: AMK75-6150 Diatom Abundance Data from Arctic Sediment Core
metadata.description: Diatom species abundance and ecological group composition data from marine sediment core AMK75-6150 collected at 74.78°N, 8.44°E in the Arctic Ocean. The dataset contains 31 depth intervals spanning 0.005 to 0.305 meters of sediment, with age estimates ranging from 0.062 to 2.847 thousand years. Data includes counts for 26 diatom species and percentages for ecological groups (warm-water, cold-water, ice-neritic, sea ice, sublittoral, freshwater, and fossil diatoms).

metadata.name: MOSAiC ice core chlorophyll a and phaeophytin concentrations
metadata.description: Measurements of chlorophyll a and phaeophytin concentrations from sea ice core samples collected during the MOSAiC expedition. The dataset includes 271 samples taken at various depths in Arctic sea ice, with associated geographic coordinates, elevation, and sample depth information.

metadata.name: Sediment Core 210Pb and 137Cs Measurements from LSMo22-1
metadata.description: Dataset containing 29 sediment core samples from event LSMo22-1 with measurements of 210Pb (total, supported, and unsupported activity concentrations) and 137Cs activity concentrations along with their standard deviations at various sediment depths. All samples were collected at a single location in Mexico (21.365278°N, -104.568333°W) at 750m elevation on 2022-04-08.

metadata.name: 210Pb sediment core measurements from LTp22-1
metadata.description: Lead-210 (210Pb) radiometric measurements from sediment core samples, including supported and unsupported 210Pb activity values with standard deviations. The dataset contains 25 depth-resolved samples from a single location with depth measurements ranging from 0.0025 to 0.235 meters.

metadata.name: Geochemical composition of sediment core LTp22-1 from the eastern Pacific
metadata.description: Geochemical measurements (Si, K, Ca, Ti, V, Cr, Mn, Fe, Ni, Cu, Zn, Ge, Sr, Zr, Cd, Ce, Ta in centered log-ratio format) from sediment core LTp22-1, including depth, age estimates, and backscatter intensity data.

metadata.name: Macoma balthica Shell Length and Frequency Data from Rönnebank, Baltic Sea
metadata.description: Dataset containing shell length measurements and frequency counts for the bivalve species Macoma balthica. The data was collected during expedition EMB320 in June 2023 at Rönnebank in the Baltic Sea. It compares samples from a Marine Protected Area against a Reference area, with 18 samples from each site.
metadata.spatial: Point locations at Rönnebank, Baltic Sea

metadata.name: Lanaittu sediment core mineralogical analysis
metadata.description: Sediment core samples from the Lanaittu core containing mineralogical composition data including heavy mineral counts, transparent/opaque/turbid fractions, and percentages of various minerals (zircon, tourmaline, rutile, garnet, titanite, epidote, zoisite+clinozoisite, chlorite, staurolite, glaucophane-crossite, kyanite, andalusite, lawsonite, vesuvianite, olivine, antimony, bromite, monazite, xenotime, corundum, and unidentified minerals). Five samples from depths 12.43-27.50 m with 2-4 phi grain size fraction.
